description: Quality Gate aggregate cases: a job conclusion of success is counted as an executed control only when the native scanner outcome says the scan ran clean.

cases.name: scanned_clean
cases.why: The scan ran clean: four executed controls.

cases.name: key_absent_is_not_an_executed_control
cases.why: Advisory skip under the existing policy: the gate passes and the scan is not counted.

cases.name: token_lacks_scope_is_not_an_executed_control
cases.why: The vendor rejected the token: not executed, not counted.

cases.name: container_failed_to_start_is_not_an_executed_control
cases.why: The scanner never started: not executed, not counted.

cases.name: success_without_native_outcome_fails
cases.why: A job conclusion alone cannot stand in for a scan result.

cases.name: success_with_unknown_native_outcome_fails
cases.why: An outcome this gate does not know is not an executed scan.

cases.name: success_with_scanner_failed_fails
cases.why: Contradiction: the scanner failed, so a success conclusion is not a scan.

cases.name: success_with_secret_detected_fails
cases.why: Contradiction: a detected secret cannot pass.

cases.name: secrets_job_skipped_fails
cases.why: A skipped job is not success, as before.

cases.name: secrets_job_cancelled_fails
cases.why: A cancelled job is not success, as before.

cases.name: other_job_failure_fails
cases.why: Existing behaviour for the other jobs is unchanged.
